All three findings fixed in one commit ([9790186](commit:9790186), not pushed).

- Cover overflow: new `coverTitleLong` helper in [panels.ts](/workspace/wt-26/app/folio/panels.ts) maps title length to `data-long` (`>24` → step 1, `>36` → step 2); [scene-page.tsx](/workspace/wt-26/app/leer/scene-page.tsx) passes it to the number and title. [chapters.css](/workspace/wt-26/app/styles/chapters.css) steps the title to 36px/30px and the number to 6.5rem/5.5rem only when long, and tightens cover-only gaps (rule, offer padding, button margins). Short titles like chapter 1 are untouched; no text is clipped.
- Strip bleed: `BlurredThumbs` in [panels-modal.tsx](/workspace/wt-26/app/folio/panels-modal.tsx) now wraps each thumb in a `.thumb-tile` with its own radius and `overflow: hidden`; the blur moved onto the inner `img`, so gaps survive in both themes.
- Lone strip tile: `.thumb-strip > :only-child` caps at 180px, left aligned.

Verified: `npm test` (37 files, 344 pass, incl. new [panels.test.ts](/workspace/wt-26/app/folio/panels.test.ts) boundary tests), typecheck, build, check:size, check:secrets all clean. No music, Player, server/images, or contracts changes; no generation; `next start` never run.

Skipped live-browser measurement, so the 41px saving is arithmetic, not observed — worth a re-check at 1280x800, worst case chapter 23.
